summary: 37 units (39-75) reviewed. 6 error, 44 minor issues (issue rows; one fix may be split over several rows/patches). Errors: 41 Hindi mis-attaches 'knowing' to the giver; 50 Hindi reads 'my garment'; 51 naḥ labelled dative but is accusative; 75 budhyamānā mislabelled passive. Recurring minor: 'this woman' added in 53-58 (neutral 'this one (f.)'); vahatu rendered two ways (66/73); Hindi term inconsistencies (payas, vāja, agha, bhaga, rakṣas). No regrouping suggested; the 3-line unit 69 is correct. Remaining doubts: 42 (datto, who gives), 47 (first line syntax), 72 (nāvagravaḥ), 74 (agatasya, referents), 64 (enau), 55 (bhajaḥ/bhago), 71 (Ama/Sā as names). Suggested GLOSSARY additions: rakṣas Hindi रक्षस्; vahatu = bridal procession (वधू-यात्रा); payas = milk (दूध); vāja = vigor (बल); agha = evil (अशुभ); bhaga = good fortune (सौभाग्य); jāmi = kinswoman; kṛtyā = spell (कृत्या); enas = offence (दोष); imām/asyai (f.) = 'this one', never 'woman/bride' unless printed.
